description: Working on the Eurobank mobile banking application within a team of 35-40 Android developers. Led a large-scale modularization effort, migrating 1,500+ files and creating 10+ new modules. Established unit test coverage across previously untested modules.

Native Android migration of Sportsbook product using Jetpack Compose and MVI architecture. Maintained sub-3% QA rejection rate, achieved 96% crash-free sessions over 6 months, and reviewed 50+ pull requests per quarter. Leveraged AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini).

Viva.com Terminal application serving 1M+ users across 10+ European countries. Implemented full tablet and landscape support across 35+ screens, enabling expansion to cash machines and vending machines. Developed Kiosk mode in Kotlin and led application rebranding.

Developed and maintained 15+ Android applications across insurance and loyalty domains. KRAFT Pro App — winner of Impact Bite Awards 2021. Piraeus Bank Yellow App — top banking app in Greece for 5 consecutive years. Tech lead for one year; sole Android developer on multiple projects with MVVM, Coroutines, Flow, and Room.
